description: Check whether a business being bought can pay for its own purchase out of profit, and what happens if it underperforms. Answers "can I afford to buy this business?" from asking price, deposit, loan terms and the annual profit of the business being bought.

annualProfit.description: Annual profit of the business being bought, before financing.

interestRatePercent.description: Annual interest rate on the borrowed balance.

name: forge_acquisition_affordability
